enchantments.tooltip: Assassinate +4: +4 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Assassinate attempts.
Insightful Assassinate +1: +1 Insight bonus to the DC of character's Assassinate attempts.

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +7 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Insightful Diversion +2%: +2% Enhancement bonus to decreased threat generated from melee damage.
Mythic Goggle Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
